name: Startup
note: Here, you have various modules available. You can uncheck the modules you do not want to use.

modules.name: Products/ Inventory/ Stock Management
modules.description: Tracks and controls stock levels, categories, product variants, location in the warehouse, and shipping.

modules.name: Fixed Asset Management
modules.description: Effortlessly track, control, and report on your organization’s fixed assets. Enables you to monitor asset inventory, categories, variants, locations, and shipping logistics, while also providing reporting capabilities for asset appreciation and depreciation. Simplify the management of valuable resources and gain insights into the financial performance of your assets.

modules.name: Stock Alert Report
modules.description: Lists stock item’s quantity available in a particular warehouse.

modules.name: Stock Report
modules.description: List stock item's quantity available in a particular warehouse. multiple Stock reports, including Sales, Quotations, Purchases, Sale and Purchase Returns, Transfers, as well as Adjustments.

modules.name: Sales Management
modules.description: Implements sales placement, sales scheduling, shipping, status and invoicing.

modules.name: Sales Report
modules.description: Reports sales of all products and analyzes sales data.

modules.name: Top Selling Products Report
modules.description: Reports which product sold in what amount, how many times, at what rate for how much amount and when (specified date).

modules.name: Shipment and Delivery Status
modules.description: Tracks the progress of shipments, delivery times, and order status updates, ensuring accurate timelines and customer notifications.

modules.name: Sales Return Tracking
modules.description: When sold Item being returned. Manages and identifies product, customer, warehouse, date, it’s effect on stock as well as revenue and its status.

modules.name: Point of Sale (POS)
modules.description: Easiest way of selling and navigating through products. Displays products with image, quantity as well as price & enables selling with barcode support.

modules.name: Product Sales Report
modules.description: Track total product sales by warehouse, customer, and date. Filterable and exportable in PDF and Excel. Gain insights into sales quantity and grand total. Inform your business decisions with this powerful reporting module.

modules.name: Purchases Return Tracking
modules.description: When purchased Item being returned. Manages and identifies product, supplier, warehouse, date, effect on stock and its status.

modules.name: Product Purchases Report
modules.description: Track total product purchases by warehouse, supplier, and date. Filterable and exportable in PDF and Excel. Gain insights into purchase quantity and grand total. Optimize costs and make informed decisions with this powerful reporting module.

modules.name: Purchase Report
modules.description: Reports purchases made for various products focusing mainly on quantity, total cost, product supply , chain status, and payment status incurred to buy that quantity for a preferred date range.

modules.name: Payment Method Management
modules.description: Facilitates the management of various payment methods, allowing organizations to streamline transactions, track payment processing, and ensure secure financial operations across multiple channels.

modules.name: Trial Balance Report
modules.description: Displays a summary of all ledger accounts with their respective balances, ensuring that total debits equal total credits for accurate financial reporting.

modules.name: General Ledger Report
modules.description: Presents a comprehensive record of all transactions in a standardized format, enabling easy tracking and review of financial activities within the general ledger.

modules.name: Monetary Transaction Tracking
modules.description: Manages the movement of funds through loans, revenues from auxiliary services, and other activities beyond core operations, providing detailed oversight for financial health and reporting.

modules.name: General Ledger and Trial Balance
modules.description: Maintains a comprehensive record of all financial transactions, facilitating the creation of a Trial Balance to ensure the accuracy and completeness of accounts, supporting effective financial reporting and analysis.

modules.name: Payment Report
modules.description: Reports payments on purchase, sales, sales return and purchase return. Also reports how much, how, when, and who paid.

modules.name: Bank Account Management
modules.description: Enables the creation and management of bank accounts while recording transaction movements, ensuring accurate financial tracking and reconciliation for better cash flow management.

modules.name: Cash on Hand Management
modules.description: Oversees cash revenues and petty cash transactions, ensuring accurate tracking, secure handling, and efficient reconciliation for effective cash flow management.

modules.name: All Tax Management
modules.description: Tracks all tax obligations related to the organization and employees, including VAT, withholding, income tax, and others to ensuring reconciliation and monitoring of payment statuses for compliance and accuracy.

modules.name: Financial Statement
modules.description: Prepares key financial documents, including Profit and Loss statements, Owner's Equity statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow statements, ensuring compliance with government regulations and standards for accurate financial reporting.

modules.name: Supplier Report
modules.description: Reports your purchases from suppliers', payments, amounts owed and paid (Credit report), as well as returned purchases.

addons.name: Profit & Loss Report
addons.description: A financial report that shows a company’s Sales, Purchases, Sales Return, Purchases Return, Expenses, revenues and Profit, Payments Received, Payments Sent, and Payments Net over a given time period.

addons.name: Daily Backup
addons.description: Sending a copy of your virtual file or database to a secondary, off-site location for preservation in case of equipment failure or catastrophe.
